svg.title: Stack tecnológico
svg.desc: Frontend: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Astro, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Framer Motion; Backend y datos: Python, Django, FastAPI, Flask, .NET, PHP, MySQL, MongoDB, Supabase; Móvil y 3D: React Native, Expo, Three.js; IA y datos: Gemini API, scikit-learn, pandas, Jupyter; Cloud y DevOps: Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, Docker, Linux, Git, GitHub; Diseño y multimedia: Figma, Photoshop, Blender
